zh.title: 房子的形状
zh.subtitle: 一套 100 万的房子，钱都去哪了
zh.summary: 按全国新房均价，一套 100 平的房子约 100 万。片子把它拆成 100 个方块，一块 1 万元：钱去了哪里（真正用来盖楼的只有 33 万），钱从哪里来，30 年一共要付多少，最后这些钱变成了什么。拆分按全国均价估算，各城市差别很大，不构成购房建议。
zh.making: 每一帧画面都由代码按时间画出，再用 Playwright 截图、ffmpeg 编码；配乐也由代码生成。没有旁白，屏幕上的每个数字都有来源。

en.title: The Shape of a Home
en.subtitle: Where does the money for a ¥1 million flat go?
en.summary: At China's average price for a new home, a 100 m² flat costs about ¥1 million. The film breaks it into 100 blocks of ¥10,000 each: where the money goes (only ¥330,000 pays for the building), where it comes from, what 30 years of payments add up to, and what the money finally becomes. The split uses national averages and varies widely between cities. In Chinese.
en.making: Every frame is drawn by code from a timeline, captured with Playwright and encoded with ffmpeg; the soundtrack is generated by code too. No narration, and every number on screen has a source.

zh.title: AI 的形状
zh.subtitle: 上百个数字，看懂 2026 年的 AI 世界
zh.summary: AI 一年便宜 13 倍，四家科技公司今年却要砸 7325 亿美元。片子用 100 多个有出处的数字，分 6 章画出 2026 年的 AI 世界：谁在用、钱从哪来到哪去、模型有多大、能力到了哪一步、中美谁领先，以及背后的数据中心和电；最后回到开头的问题。数据截至 2026 年 10 月 19 日。
zh.making: 每一帧画面都由代码按时间画出，再用 Playwright 截图、ffmpeg 编码；配乐也由代码生成，和画面共用同一套节拍。没有旁白。

en.title: The Shape of AI
en.subtitle: The AI world of 2026 in a hundred numbers
en.summary: AI gets 13 times cheaper every year, yet four tech companies will spend $732.5 billion on it this year. In six chapters and more than a hundred sourced numbers, the film draws the AI world of 2026: who uses it, where the money comes from and goes, how big the models are, what they can do, who leads between China and the US, and the data centres and power behind it all. Data as of 19 October 2026. In Chinese.
en.making: Every frame is drawn by code from a timeline, captured with Playwright and encoded with ffmpeg; the soundtrack is generated by code on the same beat grid as the pictures. No narration.

zh.title: AI 的真实价格
zh.subtitle: 全球最聪明的 AI，比 DeepSeek 还便宜？
zh.summary: 按 API 单价，Claude Opus 5.5 是 DeepSeek 的 17 倍；可对包月用满的人，它反而更便宜。片子讲清两个原因（包月和省 token），也替 DeepSeek 说句公道话，最后落到一句话：最贵的 token 是你的时间。数据截至 2026 年 10 月 21 日。
zh.making: 画面用 Remotion（React）逐帧生成，没有旁白。配乐是第三方曲目《千年之后（氛围版）》（和乐府），来源见下方数据来源和源码说明。

en.title: The Real Price of AI
en.subtitle: Is the smartest AI cheaper than DeepSeek?
en.summary: Per API token, Claude Opus 5.5 costs 17 times as much as DeepSeek; for someone who uses a monthly plan to the full, it works out cheaper. The film explains the two reasons (subscriptions and using fewer tokens), gives DeepSeek its due, and ends on one line: the most expensive token is your time. Data as of 21 October 2026. In Chinese.
en.making: Rendered frame by frame with Remotion (React), with no narration. The music is a third-party track, Qian Nian Zhi Hou (ambient version) by He Yuefu; see the source notes.
